answer: Reputation lanterns: to join the economy, an agent must lock a refundable stake and light a public lantern that vouches for its work. The lantern keeps an ivory ledger of every completed job and dispute, so a brand-new identity starts dark and worthless. Cloning thousands of fake agents means lighting thousands of lanterns, each costing real stake and real completed work — a dune of expense that grows with every copy. Sybils cannot fake time: honest history accrues slowly, and a lantern caught lying burns out and forfeits its stake.
